answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The forge graph is validated at intake and the bridge frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and meadow anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Verification costs 12 dollars and 3 days per identity, which turns a 4066 account sybil into a 13 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
